text.en: Dog owners frequently highlight that pets thrive during boarding and daycare stays at Old Mill Kennels. Clients note that even nervous or timid rescue dogs settle in quickly, enjoying outdoor play sessions and forest walks. Reviewers consistently describe dogs returning home relaxed, healthy, and enthusiastic whenever arriving back at the facility.

Reviewers express deep trust in John's dedication and close attention to animal welfare. Multiple clients recount instances where staff identified health concerns promptly, including coordinating veterinary attention when an older pet felt unwell. Pet parents feel reassured leaving their companions for both short trips and extended holiday breaks.

Pet owners appreciate the consistent communication provided while they are away on vacation. Several reviewers mention receiving frequent video clips and photographs showing their dogs playing happily in the exercise paddocks. Clients emphasize that these regular check-ins provide immense reassurance and complete peace of mind during their travels.

q.en: Does Old Mill Kennels send photo updates during boarding?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers note receiving regular photo and video updates showing their dogs enjoying exercise.

q.en: Are both daycare and overnight boarding available?

a.en: Yes, the facility provides daytime socialization care as well as extended overnight kennel stays.

q.en: How are dogs exercised during their stay?

a.en: Dogs enjoy outdoor play in secure paddocks alongside supervised walks through scenic countryside.

q.en: Can timid or anxious dogs be accommodated safely?

a.en: Reviewers report that cautious and nervous dogs settled in smoothly thanks to patient handling.
